result: No blocking finding in independent read-only source/API/test review of the integrated dependency patch.

composition.shared_file_resolution: tools/test_russian_portuguese_priority_wording.py retains both the PR117 ImageDimensions ui(id,args) assertion and PR119 ImageMemoryPolicy ui(id,args) assertions.
composition.test_only_strengthening: NumericDisplayLocaleTest replaces self-referential memoryLabel expectations with literal complete initial and refreshed budget captions for pt-BR, de, en-001, ar and ro; drains queued OnShow and dismissal callbacks and asserts dialog dismissal.

reviewed_behavior: ImageDimensions and memoryLabel use selected-resource formatting, while resize budget uses the same locale for its outer MP value.

The six NumericDisplayLocaleTest methods exercise production warning, resize budget, new/resize/canvas budget views, selection caption, recent-colour accessibility and zoom label consumers with deliberately different process defaults.
The strengthened full resize captions independently require both dependency repairs. Removing either the inner memory or outer MP repair makes non-English expectations differ.
Policy admission arithmetic, resident accounting, zoom thresholds and rounding, selection geometry, stored colour values, hexadecimal syntax and canonical numeric edit fields remain unchanged.
Existing PR117 ImageDisplayLocaleTest coverage of dimensions, grouping, memory units, English fallback, input parsing, repeated unit changes and overflow boundaries is preserved.
PR117 Brazilian Portuguese wording, sizing assertions and position-readiness fixes remain byte-for-byte preserved.

independent_checks.check: Git-blob and mode comparison against saved parent manifests
independent_checks.detail: All 1,181 untouched PR117 leaves and five copied PR119 production/resource leaves match.

independent_checks.check: Complete resize-caption literals against current XML templates through JVM Formatter
independent_checks.detail: Both budgets in five locales; negative controls cover ROOT inner memory, ROOT outer MP and opposite process-default formatting.

limits: The JVM literal/template probe is a selected-locale formatting stand-in, not Android resource-resolution or View execution.
This review did not run the integrated Robolectric, Gradle/lint, APK or installed-device stages. Exact-head hosted CI and Codex review remain required before merge.
No linguistic acceptance, full-catalogue completion, rendered clipping or physical-device coverage is claimed.

subsequent_primary_evidence.suppressed_exception: org.robolectric.android.internal.AndroidTestEnvironment$UnExecutedRunnablesException: Main looper has queued unexecuted runnables. This might be the cause of the test failure. You might need a shadowOf(Looper.getMainLooper()).idle() call.
subsequent_primary_evidence.assessment: The existing integrated test idles the main looper immediately after ImageResizeDialog.show(), before reading resize_budget. Production installs its initial refresh through setOnShowListener. This conceptually closes the demonstrated queued-OnShow/read ordering gap without altering production behavior or weakening the assertion. The additional post-Cancel idle similarly precedes dismissal/callback assertions.
subsequent_primary_evidence.scope_note: The old expected memory text was 25.7 MiB because unintegrated PR119 still used the PR117-dependent ROOT memoryLabel helper. The integrated literal expectation is 25,7 MiB and checks that dependency separately.
subsequent_primary_evidence.integrated_execution_status: pending exact-head hosted execution; the prior failure is diagnostic evidence, not proof that the integrated repair passes
